findings.title: Local forwarding exports escape the mapper re-export prohibition
mutations: Append export { application } to the actual exact mapper source while preserving its two permitted imports.
Append export { reviewed as forwardedReviewed } to the actual exact mapper source while preserving its two permitted imports.
findings.reasoning: The mapper-specific visitor rejects require identifiers and dynamic import calls, then only checks string-literal-like nodes. A local export declaration forwarding an existing imported binding contains identifiers and export specifiers but no module string, require identifier or dynamic import. Both required imports remain in seen, server-only remains present, and the final purity regex does not reject the export. The inspected guard therefore accepts these forbidden forwarding exports.
findings.requirement: C1 TASK V2 required guard behavior 3 explicitly forbids re-export under the exact two-import mapper exception.
findings.currentTestGap: The focused re-export negative replaces an allowed import with export-from containing the old module specifier. It does not append a local export of an already imported permitted metadata binding.
findings.impact: The new exception is broader than its specified metadata-only surface. This is a guard false-negative; no such forwarding export exists in the frozen runtime mapper and no current production activation is alleged.
findings.boundedCorrection: Reject local export declarations/assignments forwarding these metadata bindings, or enforce the finite current mapper export surface. Add focused appended-local-export negatives while both allowed imports stay present. Keep runtime source, old AA behavior tests, traversal and existing transitive checks unchanged.
